name: recoil_app_mfc_ole_module_destructor
description: RecoilApp::MfcOleModuleDestructor tears down the embedded chunked state queue before chaining to the MFC app destructor.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte compare passes through recoil_app_mfc_ole_module_destructor with zero unmasked mismatches after 16 relocation-masked bytes; Binary Ninja body and VC object body are both 256 bytes.

The tier S owner manifest uses vc5_o2_ob1_md_recoilapp_stl_queue_facs so VC5 sees the recovered std::deque<RecoilApp_StateQueueItem*> member for this destructor; native builds keep the recovered manual queue teardown because host STL layout is not ABI-compatible.
The embedded queue layout matches the VC5SP3 STL deque layout and retail 0x4428b0 follows the old deque destructor/pop_front/_Freefront sequence.
The native smoke constructs the MFC/OLE module state, installs an allocated queue chunk, calls the destructor helper, and checks that the queue item count and read/write blocks are cleared.
